===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|Jan|Jan.|JAN||abbreviation}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:inh|enm:Januarie<ety:from<Janevere<ety:bor<xno:genever<ety:der<la:Iānuārius>>>>>>|tree=1}}
From {{inh|en|enm|Januarie}}, {{m|enm|januari}}, re-latinised forms of {{cog|enm|Janevere}}, {{m|enm|Ieneuer}}, from {{der|en|xno|genever}}, from {{der|en|la|Iānuārius||(month) of Janus}}, a compound of {{com|la|Iānus|-ārius||pos1="[[Janus]]"|pos2=adjectival suffix|nocat=1}}, with the first element perhaps from the [[Proto-Indo-European]] root {{m|ine-pro|*yeh₂-||to go}}. {{doublet|en|Gennaro}}.

===Pronunciation===

* {{enPR|jănʹyo͞o-ĕr'ē|a=US}}, {{IPA|en|/ˈd͡ʒæn.juˌɛɹi/|/ˈd͡ʒæn.juˌæɹi/}}

* {{IPA|en|/ˈd͡ʒan.jʉuˌəɹi/|a=IE}}

* {{a|en|UK}} {{hyphenation|en|Janu|ary}}

===Proper noun===
{{en-prop|ies|s}}

# {{senseid|en|Q108}}The first [[month]] of the [[Gregorian calendar]], following the [[December]] of the previous year and preceding [[February]].
#: {{alti|en|Jan<id:Q108>|Jan.<id:Q108>|JAN<id:Q108>|mul:1<id:Q108>}}
#: {{syn|en|First Month|q=Quakerism}}
#: {{hol|en|calendar year<id:Q3186692>|;|year<id:Q577>}}
#: {{comeronyms|en|February<id:Q109>|March<id:Q110>|April<id:Q118>|May<id:Q119>|June<id:Q120>|July<id:Q121>|August<id:Q122>|September<id:Q123>|October<id:Q124>|November<id:Q125>|December<id:Q126>}}
#: ''01/01/09'' : [[Thursday]], 1st '''January'''(,) 2009.
#: ''American style:'' [[Thursday]], '''January''' 1st, 2009.
#: {{ux|en|I hate '''Januarys''': it's always too cold.}}
#* {{RQ:en:New York Times|author=Sophie Atkinson|title=Andy Warhol’s Secrets for Surviving Isolation|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2020/06/30/magazine/the-philosophy-of-andy-warhol.html|date=2020-06-30|passage=I get sick a lot in the winter, so I spent this past '''January''' as I’ve spent many '''Januaries''' before it — in bed with a standard-issue flu.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20201104072318/https://www.nytimes.com/2020/06/30/magazine/the-philosophy-of-andy-warhol.html}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Amir Vera|title=Louisville detective who fatally shot Breonna Taylor is appealing his termination from the police department|url=https://www.cnn.com/2021/12/13/us/myles-cosgrove-breonna-taylor-termination-appeal-hearing/index.html|date=2021-12-13|passage=The Louisville Metro Police Department terminated Detective Myles Cosgrove in '''January''' for use of deadly force for firing 16 rounds into Taylor’s home and failing to activate his body camera, according to a copy of his termination letter.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220327164409/https://www.cnn.com/2021/12/13/us/myles-cosgrove-breonna-taylor-termination-appeal-hearing/index.html}}
# {{lb|en|rare}} {{given name|en|female|from=month names < English}}.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2011|author=Michael Schofield|title=January First
|passage=“Hi, '''January'''!” Lynn calls. “Happy birthday!”}}
